posts.content:
WE ARE HIRING | DATA ANALYST – AJMAN, UAE
Salary: AED 14,500/month

Ramtech is looking for a skilled Data Analyst to support a government authority in Ajman through data analysis, Power BI dashboards, management reporting and data quality management.

Key Requirements:
2–5 years of experience in Data Analysis / Business Intelligence.
Strong hands-on experience with Power BI and SQL.
Experience developing dashboards, reports, KPIs and data visualizations.
Good knowledge of Excel, data cleaning, validation and ETL/data transformation.
Experience analysing enterprise system data and preparing management reports.
Knowledge of Python/R, data modelling and API integration is an advantage.
Preferred Candidate Profile:
Candidates with prior experience working on UAE Government Entity projects or in Audit, Regulatory, Compliance or Public Sector environments will be highly preferred.

📍 Location: Ajman, UAE
💰 Salary: AED 14,500/month
📧 Apply: adev@ramtech-corp.com
📝 Email Subject: Data Analyst – Ajman
📱 WhatsApp: 058 145 6683

Interested candidates who meet the requirements are encouraged to share their updated CV.

Please share this opportunity with relevant Data Analytics and Power BI professionals.
